verses.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Os fariseus, e alguns dos escribas, que tinham vindo de Jerusalém, reuniram-se com ele.
verses.en_web: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And there came together to him the Pharisees and certain of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem,

verses.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
verses.pt: E, quando viram que alguns dos discípulos dele comiam pão com mãos impuras, isto é, sem lavar, repreendiam-lhes.
verses.en_web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
verses.en_bbe: And had seen that some of his disciples took their bread with unclean, that is, unwashed, hands.

verses.en: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.pt: (Pois os fariseus, e todos os judeus, mantendo a tradição dos antigos, se não lavarem bastante as mãos, não comem.
verses.en_web: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews, don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Pharisees, and all the Jews, do not take food without washing their hands with care, keeping the old rule which has been handed down to them:

verses.en: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
verses.pt: E, quando voltam da rua, se não se lavarem, não comem; e há muitas outras coisas que se encarregam de guardar, como lavar os copos, as vasilhas, os utensílios de metal, e os leitos).
verses.en_web: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
verses.en_bbe: And when they come from the market-place, they take no food till their hands are washed; and a number of other orders there are, which have been handed down to them to keep--washings of cups and pots and brass vessels.

verses.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
verses.pt: Depois os fariseus e os escribas lhe perguntaram: Por que os teus discípulos não andam conforme a tradição dos antigos, em vez de comerem pão com as mãos sem lavar?
verses.en_web: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
verses.en_bbe: And the Pharisees and the scribes put the question to him, Why do your disciples not keep the rules of the fathers, but take their bread with unwashed hands?

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.pt: E ele lhes respondeu: Bem profetizou Isaías acerca de vós, hipócritas! Como está escrito: Este povo me honra com os lábios, mas o seu coração está longe de mim.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Well did Isaiah say of you, you false ones: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

verses.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.pt: Eles, porém, me honram em vão, ensinando como doutrinas mandamentos humanos. Isaías 29:13
verses.en_web: But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
verses.en_bbe: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.

verses.en: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
verses.pt: Pois vós deixais o mandamento de Deus, e mantendes a tradição humana, como lavar as vasilhas e os copos; e fazeis muitas outras coisas semelhantes a estas.
verses.en_web: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
verses.en_bbe: For, turning away from the law of God, you keep the rules of men.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
verses.pt: E dizia-lhes: Vós dispensais o mandamento de Deus para guardardes a vossa tradição;
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Truly you put on one side the law of God, so that you may keep the rules which have been handed down to you.

verses.en: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.pt: porque Moisés disse: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe. E quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe terá de morrer.
verses.en_web: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
verses.en_bbe: For Moses said, Give honour to your father and mother, and, He who says evil of father or mother, let him have the punishment of death:

verses.en: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
verses.pt: Mas vós dizeis: Se o homem disser ao pai ou à mãe: Tudo o que te puder aproveitar de mim é corbã (isto é, oferta),
verses.en_web: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God”;’
verses.en_bbe: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is Corban, that is to say, Given to God,

verses.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
verses.pt: então não lhe deixais mais nada fazer por seu pai ou por sua mãe.
verses.en_web: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
verses.en_bbe: You no longer let him do anything for his father or his mother;

verses.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
verses.pt: Assim invalidaias a palavra de Deus por vossa tradição, que ordenastes; e fazeis muitas coisas semelhantes a estas.
verses.en_web: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
verses.en_bbe: Making the word of God of no effect by your rule, which you have given: and a number of other such things you do.

verses.en: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
verses.pt: E chamando para si toda a multidão, disse-lhes: Ouvi-me todos, e entendei:
verses.en_web: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
verses.en_bbe: And turning to the people again, he said to them, Give ear to me all of you, and let my words be clear to you:

verses.en: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
verses.pt: Nada há fora do ser humano que nele entre que o possa contaminar; mas o que dele sai, isso é o que contamina o ser humano.
verses.en_web: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
verses.en_bbe: There is nothing outside the man which, going into him, is able to make him unclean: but the things which come out of the man are those which make the man unclean.

verses.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.pt: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.en_web: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

verses.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
verses.pt: Quando Jesus deixou a multidão e entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram sobre a parábola.
verses.en_web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had gone into the house away from all the people, his disciples put questions to him about the saying.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Também vós estais assim sem entendimento? Não entendeis que tudo o que de fora entra no ser humano não o pode contaminar?
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Have even you so little wisdom? Do you not see that whatever goes into a man from outside is not able to make him unclean,

verses.en: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
verses.pt: Pois não entra no seu coração, mas, sim, no ventre, e sai para a privada. (Assim, ele declarou como limpas todas as comidas).
verses.en_web: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?”
verses.en_bbe: Because it goes not into the heart but into the stomach, and goes out with the waste? He said this, making all food clean.

verses.en: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.pt: E dizia: O que sai do ser humano, isso contamina o ser humano.
verses.en_web: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that makes the man unclean.

verses.en: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
verses.pt: Pois é de dentro do coração humano que vêm os maus pensamentos, os adultérios, os pecados sexuais, os homicídios,
verses.en_web: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
verses.en_bbe: Because from inside, from the heart of men, come evil thoughts and unclean pleasures,

verses.en: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
verses.pt: os roubos, as ganâncias, as maldades, o engano, a depravação, o olho malicioso, a blasfêmia, a soberba, a insensatez.
verses.en_web: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
verses.en_bbe: The taking of goods and of life, broken faith between husband and wife, the desire of wealth, wrongdoing, deceit, sins of the flesh, an evil eye, angry words, pride, foolish acts:

verses.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
verses.pt: Todos estes males procedem de dentro, e contaminam o ser humano.
verses.en_web: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”
verses.en_bbe: All these evil things come from inside, and make the man unclean.

verses.en: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
verses.pt: Jesus levantou-se dali e foi para a região de Tiro e de Sidom. Ele entrou numa casa, e não queria que ninguém soubesse disso, mas não pôde se esconder.
verses.en_web: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
verses.en_bbe: And he went away from there to the country of Tyre and Sidon. And he went into a house, desiring that no man might have knowledge of it: and he was not able to keep it secret.

verses.en: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
verses.pt: Pois uma mulher, cuja filhinha tinha um espírito imundo, assim que ouviu falar dele, veio, e prostrou-se a seus pés.
verses.en_web: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
verses.en_bbe: But a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having had news of him, came straight away and went down at his feet.

verses.en: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
verses.pt: Esta mulher era grega, de nacionalidade sirofenícia; e rogava-lhe que expulsasse o demônio de sua filha.
verses.en_web: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.en_bbe: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syro-phoenician by birth: and she made a request to him that he would send the evil spirit out of her daughter.

verses.en: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus lhe disse: Deixa primeiro que os filhos se fartem; porque não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos, e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.
verses.en_web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, Let the children first have their food: for it is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.

verses.en: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
verses.pt: Porém ela lhe respondeu: Sim Senhor; mas também os cachorrinhos comem debaixo da mesa, das migalhas que os filhos deixam.
verses.en_web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
verses.en_bbe: But she said to him in answer, Yes, Lord: even the dogs under the table take the bits dropped by the children.

verses.en: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.pt: Então ele lhe disse: Por esta palavra, vai, o demônio já saiu da tua filha.
verses.en_web: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, For this saying go your way; the evil spirit has gone out of your daughter.

verses.en: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
verses.pt: Quando ela chegou à sua casa, encontrou que o demônio já havia saído, e a filha estava deitada sobre a cama.
verses.en_web: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
verses.en_bbe: And she went away to her house, and saw the child on the bed, and the evil spirit gone out.

verses.en: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
verses.pt: Então Jesus voltou a sair da região de Tiro e de Sidom, e veio para o mar da Galilea, por meio da região de Decápolis.
verses.en_web: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
verses.en_bbe: And again he went out from Tyre, and came through Sidon to the sea of Galilee, through the country of Decapolis.

verses.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
verses.pt: E trouxeram-lhe um surdo que dificilmente falava, e rogaram-lhe que pusesse a mão sobre ele.
verses.en_web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to him with one who had no power of hearing and had trouble in talking; and they made a request to him to put his hands on him.

verses.en: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
verses.pt: E tomando-o em separado da multidão, pôs os seus dedos nos ouvidos dele, cuspiu, e tocou-lhe a língua.
verses.en_web: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.
verses.en_bbe: And he took him on one side from the people privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he put water from his mouth on the man's tongue with his finger;

verses.en: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.pt: Depois, levantando os olhos ao céu, suspirou, e disse: Efatá, (isto é, abre-te).
verses.en_web: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
verses.en_bbe: And looking up to heaven, he took a deep breath, and said to him, Ephphatha, that is, Be open.

verses.en: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.pt: Imediatamente os ouvidos dele se abriram, e o que prendia sua língua se soltou, e passou a falar bem.
verses.en_web: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
verses.en_bbe: And his ears became open, and the band of his tongue was made loose, and his words became clear.

verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
verses.pt: Jesus lhes mandou que a ninguém dissessem; porém, quanto mais lhes mandava, mais divulgavam.
verses.en_web: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave them orders not to give news of it to anyone; but the more he made this request, so much the more they made it public.

verses.en: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.pt: E ficavam muito admirados, dizendo: Ele faz tudo bem! Aos surdos faz ouvir, e aos mudos falar.
verses.en_web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!”
verses.en_bbe: And they were overcome with wonder, saying, He has done all things well: he even gives back the power of hearing and the power of talking to those who have been without them.
